positions.summary: KQED reports that Brown Garibay believes families should have access to neighborhood schools but says requiring families to attend their neighborhood school now would not be fair because schools have not been resourced equitably.

positions.subject: q:education/sfusd-spend-reserves
positions.summary: Brown Garibay supports keeping the state-required reserve plus a reasonable additional reserve, and directing money beyond that to student services.

citations.quote: I support maintaining the reserves required by the state along with a reasonable additional reserve so that SFUSD is prepared for unforeseen challenges without immediately having to make cuts at schools.
Beyond that, I want our dollars going toward the things we know students need.
